notes.text: Town (zone JoppaWorld.11.22.1.1.10, parasang 11,22). Re-entering it saved the game (Roleplay checkpoint). Lies between the Great Salt Desert Moghra'yi and the jungles of Qud to the east.
Village elder. Will pay for the vermin quest. On 'work' pointed to Mehmet and Argyve. Offers trade and the water ritual (1 dram).
Gave the quest What's Eating the Watervine?: kill the vermin eating the watervine at Red Rock and bring a corpse back. Vermin: spider-like, seen in the brine; red shale flecks in the pool.
Tinker in the sheet-metal hut. Gave the quest Fetch Argyve a Knickknack: an artifact from around Joppa (the marsh surface, the rust wells to the east, or the desert).
About two parasangs north of Joppa, so probably parasang 11,20 on the world map (unconfirmed). Target of the vermin quest.
Merchant (by title); not talked to yet.
(11,21) between Joppa and Red Rock is salt marsh. Each world-map step took 300 turns, and the waterskin was poured out on each one.
Entered the middle zone (JoppaWorld.11.20.1.1.10) at night (Waning Beetle Moon) at turn 46837, arriving at (40,24) on its south edge. Arriving completed the quest step Travel to Red Rock: +50 XP.
Hungry again at turn 47236, about 400 turns after eating at 46838.
Killed at turn 47243 with one battle-axe blow (hit x3, 5 damage, roll [9]); it had missed once with thorns [3 vs 6]. +25 XP. No damage taken.

Hostile, mobile and 'skittish': hovered 2 cells away without closing in, so I went to it. Fangs: 2 damage per bite, often 2 attacks a turn. Look: Average. Took about 10 damage over 5 exchanges (it went to Badly Wounded); I took 8. +50 XP. Not the quest's vermin (Find the Vermin stayed open); no corpse dropped. Red Rock stratum 1 (26,23), turn 47390.
Item description: 'Heals and confuses when eaten.' Listed under Meds. Eaten via inventory menu a) eat.
Eaten at 8/18 HP mid-fight (turn 47539): healed to full (18/18) at once, plus 'You become confused!'. Confusion scrambles names, even in the snapshot (the centipede showed as 'Uherchuummuh'). 3 left.
Replay: level 2 again at turn 47540 (one blow on the Wounded centipede after the bark). Auto-eat ate 2 jerky on arrival at stratum 2 (Hungry → Sated). 3 servings of jerky left.
Confusion from one piece lasted at most 20 turns (gone by turn 47561, eaten at 47539). No message marks its end; names read normally again.
Found where the giant centipede died, Red Rock 2 strata deep (25,11); stepping on the cell picked it up and completed 'Find a Knickknack' (no XP). Carrying it for Argyve.
Turned in the weird artifact (unexamined, a mistake) at turn ~48270: +75 XP, quest Fetch Argyve a Knickknack complete. He then gave 'Fetch Argyve Another Knickknack'.
bent metal sheet (4 lb) and fractured microchip (2 lb): 'A piece of scrap was shed or peeled off a machine fossil.' Tinkering material; no use to us without Tinkering. Selling to price it in water.

Trades for drams of fresh water ($ = drams). At turn ~48322 bought our 2 bent metal sheets + fractured microchip for 5 drams (water 24 → 29). Sells: vinewafer x14 at $0.03, starapple $0.29, torches $2.86, leather armor $14.29, chain mail $71.43, bronze long sword $42.86, weird artifact $85.71, small mossy tube $114.29, glowsphere $114.29, ammo. Our prices: bear jerky $0.35/serving, witchwood bark $1.40 (x3), empty waterskin $1.75.
Food bought from Tam: 14 for 1 dram ($0.03 each). 'A little nub of cork swells with moisture...' Weight 0.

First live use (turn 48948, Red Rock stratum 2): at an adjacent, Wounded cave spider with the game's target locked on it. 'You emit a freezing ray from your hands! The frozen cave spider takes 2 damage.' The spider showed as 'frozen' and took no action; the next blow killed it (crit, 4 damage). Use it adjacent too.
This timeline: killed at turn 48949 (+50 XP) after melee (5 damage dealt, took 9) plus Freezing Ray; it was adjacent when the fight started (no opener).
used at turn 49034: The frozen cave spider takes 3 damage from your freezing effect! | You emit a freezing ray from your hands! | The cave spider hits (x1) for 2 damage with its fangs. [8]
Hydration food, not hunger food: +500 hydration (a dram of water is 10,000), no satiation (wiki). Eating 2 left us Hungry. Keep for thirst, not hunger.

Levels Sated / Hungry / Famished. Hungry has no penalty; Famished costs 10 quickness. Snacks like bear jerky give partial satiation; cooked meals (campfire: Make Camp + Meal Preparation) restore hunger fully (wiki). Auto-eat now waits for Famished.

used at turn 49178: The frozen giant amoeba takes 2 damage from your freezing effect! | You emit a freezing ray from your hands! | The giant amoeba misses you with its slimy pseudopod! [5 vs 6] | The giant amoeba hits (x3) for 5 damage with its slimy pseudopod. [11]

Rated Average by Look, but one turn did 4 (x2) + 7 (x3) with slimy pseudopods: 21 → 5 HP within 3 turns (turn 49177-49180, Red Rock stratum 2 at 14,12). Our blows did 2; Freezing Ray was used first. AVOID: 'Average' undersold it badly.

Escaped at 5 HP by walking straight away (game pathing to the stairs at 65,11): it moved into my old cell once, then fell out of view and never caught up over ~50 cells (turns 49181-49229). Slow; running works. HP regenerated 5 → 15 on the way. Still alive on stratum 2 near (14,11).
used at turn 49498: The frozen wet cave spider takes 2 damage from your freezing effect! | You emit a freezing ray from your hands!

Level 3 at turn 49507 (cave spider kill, finished by hand while confused after eating witchwood bark at 10/21 bleeding). +4 max HP (25), +66 SP (132 unspent), +1 MP (2 unspent), +1 attribute point (unspent). 2 witchwood bark left.
Its bite can cause bleeding ('You begin bleeding!', ~1 damage some turns, ended by itself after ~25 turns). Third kill at turn 49507: opened with automatic Freezing Ray, then melee.

Level-3 points spent (turn ~49530): IN 14 → 15 (SP 132 → 140; unlocks IN-15 skills: Mind's Compass, Meal Preparation, Harvestry); Freezing Ray rank 2 (2d3+1; rank 3 refused: 'You may not advance this mutation's rank yet'); Multiple Legs rank 2 (+40 move speed, +7% carry). 140 SP saved for Cleave (150).
Also satiates: eaten Hungry at 47539 -> Sated; eaten Hungry at 49501 -> still Hungry (partial, or the meter was deeper). Not on the auto-eat list (confusion).

Wiki (mechanics): the meter rises 1 per turn; Hungry at 1200, Famished at 2400 with no skills; a raw corpse can only be eaten when Famished (old note: makes you ill). Our record: jerky at 46837 -> Hungry again by 47237, so a jerky serving only partly fills it. Last full Sated: bark at 47539.

Take stock at turn 49529 (Red Rock stratum 2, 51,21): HP 22/25, Hungry with no hunger food (2 witchwood bark only), 24 drams fresh water + 11 vinewafers, 9 torches, sellables: 2 copper nugget, 2 silver nugget, bronze ingot. Retreat: stairs up (65,11) ~14 cells, stratum 1 stairs up adjacent at (66,11), surface to world map, 2 world steps south (600 turns) to Joppa. Known threats on that route: none seen near the stairs; amoeba (avoid) last near (14,11) on stratum 2, far west.

You are fleeing from a dreadroot!' and we fled one cell; the next blow killed it (2 damage total). No XP, no damage taken. Walking past it adjacent didn't trigger the aura.

Hidden trap creature under bones (wiki): emerges when walked over, damage plus bleeding; reveal and kill by attacking its square. Resists cold 50 and electricity 50, heat -25 (so Freezing Ray is weak on it). Seen at (48,23) on Red Rock stratum 3, turn 50001; Look on that cell showed only the bones.

Food (inventory category Food, 1 lb). Eaten Famished at turn 50075 (by a mis-key, unexamined): 'That hits the spot! You are now Hungry' plus 'You are overwhelmed with terror!' (terrified a few turns). So it satiates partly and frightens: only eat with nothing hostile around.

Famished at turn 50075 (wiki estimate from last full Sated at 47539 was ~49939: close). Dreadroot tuber brought it back to Hungry. 500-turn explore window (from 49529) ended: XP 525 -> 1030/1060, stratum 2 fully explored, stratum 3 partly. Kills this window: 3 bats, 3 giant centipedes, 3 snapjaw scavengers, 2 dreadroots, 2 jilted lovers. Second giant amoeba on stratum 3 (seen at 71,9): Freezing Ray did 4 and froze it, Look still Fine afterwards (four pseudopods); it followed slowly along the row-5 corridor and gave up out of sight.

Stratum 3 fight (turns 50080-50085): Freezing Ray 5 damage, froze it, but the freeze held a turn at most (it moved and struck 2 turns later; at 49178 it struck in the same exchange). One exchange: crit 6 ('You are dazed') + 8 + 7 = 21 damage. Total damage dealt ~9 (4 + 5); sidebar showed it Injured. Never stay within reach: it can do most of our HP in one turn.

Used once, at HP 4 adjacent to the giant amoeba (turn 50084): cursor aimed about 36 west/11 south of us at ~(20,16); landed at (32,14), 25 cells from the amoeba, out of its sight. 'Teleport to a random location within a designated area. Uncertainty radius: 12. Cooldown: 100 rounds.' Picker opens unlocked on the player; Keypad keys move the cursor without spending time.

Its terror lasted about 10 turns (eaten 50075, gone by 50085), much longer than the dreadroot's aura (~4). Terror overrides moves (we 'fled from a puddle' into the amoeba). Explore now waits out terrified/dazed/confused before acting.
From a critical hit (the amoeba's): AG 18 -> 14, IN 15 -> 11, DV 6 -> 4, move speed 140 -> 130 while it lasted (about a turn).
Correction to the stat drop above: we were terrified at the same time, so part of AG 14 / IN 11 / DV 4 / MS 130 may be terror's; both were gone by turn 50085.

Killed at turn 50262 (stratum 1, 53,19) by one Freezing Ray from 4 cells: 5 damage and it died, +25 XP. It shot us from out of view first (seeds for 2 at 5 cells: it sees farther than our torch light). Earlier timeline at level 2 it took us 18 -> 6 in melee range; from range with the ray it's easy.

Third one killed at turn 51816 with no damage taken: musket point-blank 12 (x2) -> Injured, Freezing Ray 5 ('stuck in a frozen pool of slime', it couldn't move), one axe blow 5 -> dead. +25 XP. With chain mail (AV 3) its two swings missed [1 vs 6]. Verdict now fight, shoot=yes (the routine opens with the musket).

Fear Aura acts on its own, not only when attacked: at turn 51885 autoexplore passed one at ~3 cells (never attacking, and you can't walk over it: it's a creature in its cell) and we were terrified; at 49754 it came after our first blow; walking past one adjacent earlier didn't trigger it. So it's the plant's ability with some chance/cooldown and a range of at least 3. Verdict now ignore (no XP, ammo wasted); the danger is terror near other hostiles (explore waits terror out; a hostile in view raises the LLM).

Verdict back to fight (the user: dangerous to leave on the map, chop them down). Ray from range or the axe; not the musket (can't reach us). Marked harmless: terror with only a dreadroot in view is waited out, not raised.

Stratum 4 (slime field), seen at (24,12) on arrival, turn 52172. Look on its cell showed nothing (hidden, like the young ivory under bones). Treated as a young ivory variant: immobile trap, kill it with the axe (cold resist 50 per the young ivory's wiki page).

THE VERMIN of 'What's Eating the Watervine?' (Red Rock stratum 4, slime field). Seeing one finished 'Find the Vermin' (+100 XP); killed one at turn 52182 by hand (+90 XP; claws hit 1-4, AV 4 blocked several; our HP 26 -> 17); taking its corpse ('defanged girshling corpse', heavy: load 94 -> 148) finished 'Get a Corpse' (+100 XP). Last step: return to Joppa (Mehmet) with the corpse. Swarmer, Average.

Turned in the girshling corpse at turn 53268 (Mehmet sent us to him). Dialogue: girshlings are creatures of plague from the cave under the Cloaca (sleeping Agolgot); defanged ones point to a gyre wight binding teeth for the Girsh nephilim (seventh plague, titans born on the Moon Stair). Reward: ubernostrum injector, weird artifact, 3 salve injectors, +750 XP, +200 Joppa reputation.

Bought from Tam for 14 drams (turn 53295) without checking the mechanic: shields add their AV only on a successful block (about 25% of melee attacks without the Block skill, 50% with it; wiki), while the DV penalty (-1) is always on. Sidebar stayed AV 4, DV 6 -> 5. Unequipped; kept for a Shield skill later. Lesson: check a gear mechanic before buying.

Turn 53342: 'Here is your knickknack. [give artifact]' opened 'Choose an artifact to give' listing only the ubernostrum injector and the salve injectors; the weird artifact from Elder Irudad (in the pack) wasn't offered. Earlier (turn ~48270) a weird artifact we found ourselves was accepted. Left the quest open; maybe it needs an artifact we find, or an identified one.

Historic sites (journal, turn 53342): Duramur is '9 parasangs west of the Yd Freehold' (Yd Freehold not found yet); Maggatum is '3 parasangs east of Joppa' (so about parasang 14,22). Reaching Maggatum completes Visit Maggatum and the Locate Maggatum step of Recover Analogucus Ithri-Sehfriend (then Old Shekish).

Historic site, parasang 14,22 (3 east of Joppa). Arriving completed Visit Maggatum (+250 XP). Held by the hostile Third Ithri-Sehian Family: at least five feral dogs (Easy, swarmers), a guard dog, two giant amoebas, seen from the south edge (42,24) on arrival (turn 54392).

Level 5 (wiki), moderately high AV plus a level-5 Carapace mutation. Seen 4 in the desert canyon south of Maggatum (14,22 zone 1,2), turn 54403. Marked shoot (musket penetration 8) plus the ray.

Fight 54392-54496: feral dogs 5 XP each (not worth it), chameleon 125, tortoise 125 (bled out), amoebas 12-25. Two guard dogs still alive; a guard dog was adjacent at the end. Leaving needs distance: 'There are hostiles nearby!' blocks the world map.

Ubernostrum injector: 'A torrent of life rushes over you', +3 HP per turn for ~10 turns. Salve injector: 'wounds start to close', +3 HP per turn for a few turns. Applying one took no turn. 2 salves were used at 54430 and 54490; 1 salve left.

DIED at turn 54497, Maggatum (14,22), level 6 (reached at 54496, XP 3348/5245): bitten to death by a slimy guard dog (8 in one bite) at HP 5, flanked by two irritable tortoises, after a long fight with the Third Ithri-Sehian Family's dogs and amoebas and the canyon tortoises. Death screen offers Reload from checkpoint (last checkpoint: leaving Joppa, turn ~53342, level 5, before Maggatum).

Carapace mutation (wiki): AV bonus 3 + level/2 (about +5 at level 5) and heat/cold resistance 5 + 5*level (+30, so the ray is weakened); 'tightens his carapace' doubles the AV bonus (+10) at -2 DV while it stays still, 'carapace loosens' when it moves again. A tightened tortoise can't chase: step away, or strike once it loosens.

Turn 53666 (after the reload): gave the ubernostrum injector as the knickknack (the user: fine, worth ~12 drams to us): +150 XP, Fetch Argyve Another Knickknack complete. New quest: Weirdwire Conduit... Eureka! - find 200 feet of wire, 'scavenge it from the rust wells' (Argyve earlier: the rust wells to the east of Joppa), return to Argyve.
